# Synthetic field-report corpus

**All data here is synthetic.** It was generated by [`src/generate_corpus.py`](../src/generate_corpus.py) (seed 42) and contains no personal data.

```bash
python src/generate_corpus.py --n 2000 --seed 42
```

## `field_reports.csv`: 2,000 reports (1,574 Aido Rover, 426 Fari), Jan–Jun 2026
| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `report_id`, `timestamp` | ID and time of the report |
| `platform`, `site`, `zone` | Aido Rover patrol site and zone; Fari coarse area only (privacy rule, no home locations) |
| `lat`, `lon` | Rover: position within the patrol zone. Fari: area centroid |
| `temperature_c` | Ambient temperature (Rover) |
| `author_role` | operator / technician / guard (Rover); care_staff / family / resident_via_staff (Fari) |
| `text` | Free-text report with realistic shorthand, typos and mixed issues |
| `battery_pct`, `battery_drop_pct_1h`, `motor_current_mean_a`, `motor_current_trend_a_per_h`, `speed_mean_mps`, `loc_confidence_min` | Rover telemetry for the hour before the report |
| `response_latency_s` | Fari mean response latency for the hour before the report |

## `sealed/`: answer key (do not open before Week 3)
The generator's labels and planted patterns are kept sealed so they cannot influence the gold set (labelled from the Taxonomy Guide) or the Week 2 classifier. Integrity check:

```
sha256(sealed/answer_key.csv) = 24e41dccba8d5f6436f881c61fc3c2f815f0c67e797a91ad148d06a7a16777d5
```

## Supplementary files for Week 3 (`src/generate_exposure.py`, seed 2026)
Week 3 compares incident rates and pre-incident vs normal telemetry, which the corpus alone cannot support. These files were generated **after** the corpus, without reading or changing it or the answer key.

```bash
python src/generate_exposure.py --seed 2026
```

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `exposure_hours.csv` | 756 rows: operating hours per week × Rover site-zone (25) or Fari area (3), 27 weeks. About equal effort per site-zone (the corpus placed reports uniformly), ±10% weekly noise |
| `normal_telemetry.csv` | 3,000 one-hour windows with no incident report (2,353 Rover, 647 Fari), drawn from the generator's no-incident baseline distributions |

Because both are drawn from stated assumptions rather than measured, rate and telemetry findings show what the method can detect, not real fleet behaviour.
